_comment: Trigger routing cases — forge suite scope. `expect` lists every acceptable answer; 'none' means no skill should trigger. Near-miss sibling pairs are the point — they catch description regressions that steal or lose routing. `forge-principles` names economy/security/tests/robustness, so the cases pinned to forge-review / forge-harden-scope / forge-ambition exist to prove the worldview skill doesn't steal the doing-skills' routing. Lizard cases return when the suite widens beyond forge (run.mjs --all).
